observations: Extreme close-up of a sewing machine head, showing only the top-left corner near the hand wheel.
No motor, no stand/table, no power cord, no pedal, and no full machine body visible in the single photo.
Watermark 'NATHANZ SEWING EQUIPMENT' overlaid on the image, seller's own branding, not proof of item condition.
No view of needle plate, bobbin area, or stitching in progress to judge function.

claims.evidence: No motor or drive mechanism visible in photo 0; direct-drive vs clutch/belt motor cannot be judged from this crop.
Head styling is consistent with an industrial machine, but no table, motor, or stand shown to confirm a complete industrial setup.

risks.risk: Unknown motor type (direct-drive vs clutch) affects value and usability claim.
risks.proof: Photo of the underside/motor mount showing the drive unit attached to the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified drive type, not assumed direct-drive

risks.risk: Unknown completeness: no table, stand, pedal, or power cable shown.
risks.proof: Full-body photo showing the machine mounted on its table with motor and pedal.

risks.risk: Unproven working condition; no stitching demo or power-on shown.
risks.proof: Short video of the machine running and sewing a test seam.

risks.risk: Possible cosmetic wear or damage hidden outside the cropped frame.
risks.proof: Wide-angle photos from multiple sides of the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as visibly worn, no premium for 'excellent condition'

proof_requests: Full photo of the entire machine including motor, table/stand, and pedal.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching a test piece.
Close-up of the motor and drive mechanism to confirm direct-drive claim.
Photos from multiple angles showing overall cosmetic condition.
response.reason: Brand and model (Emel EM81) are legible, and the item type (industrial sewing machine head) is clear enough to price, but with no motor, stand, or working demo shown, it must be priced at worst case as an incomplete, unverified-function unit rather than a proven complete industrial setup.
